rules.roads: Natural Earth 1:10m roads in Spain, sampled every 4 km and snapped to links between hex centres. Class 0: every motorway (Natural Earth major highways marked as expressways). Class 1: the other Natural Earth roads of scale rank 7 or less, where no motorway already links the same two hexes. Stretches over neighbouring countries are dropped.
rules.rail: Natural Earth 1:10m railways of scale rank 7 or less, sampled every 4 km and snapped to links between hex centres; tier 0 (main line) is scale rank 5 or less. Natural Earth only has the main lines and no traffic data.
rules.ports: The 28 Port Authorities of Puertos del Estado by total cargo traffic, each in the land service area of its largest port.
rules.airports: Every airport and heliport in the AENA network, classed like the FAA hubs by their share of Spain's passengers (large, 1% or more; medium, 0.25%; small, 0.05%; the rest, no hub class).
